subject: Financial Management and Strategic Management
paper_name: Paper-6: Financial Management and Strategic Management
question_text:
6.  
The capital structure of JKL Limited consists of 12% debentures of ` 50 lakhs, 10% 
preference shares of ` 25 lakhs, 14% term loan of ` 15 lakhs and equity share capital of 
` 48 lakhs. Its reserves & surpluses are ` 24 lakhs. What would be the capital-gearing 
ratio? 
(a)  
1.04 
(b)  
1.25 
(c)  
1.33 
(d)  
1.56 
(2 Marks)
suggested_answer: (B) 1.25 Capital gearing ratio = (Pref share capital + Debentures + Other borrowed funds) Equity Share Capital + Reserves and Surplus - Losses = ` 25 lakhs + ` 50 lakhs + ` 15 lakhs ` 48 lakhs + ` 24 lakhs = ` 90 lakhs / ` 72 lakhs = 1.25
